answer: Our proposed mechanism incorporates a stake-slashing matrix to combat Sybil attacks, where agents with excessive, low-weight signatures are flagged as malicious, their staking rewards docked, and their reputation commitment invalidated, rendering them unable to participate in the network, akin to a marble being ejected from a game, thereby preventing the fable of an attacker creating multiple identities, and securing the jetty of our decentralized protocol against Byzantine faults.
